description: Plain-language risk notes for Android permissions and device signals. Weights are heuristic and editable; a high score means 'worth a careful look', not 'proven malicious'.

permissions.name: READ_SMS
permissions.label: read your text messages
permissions.harm: Can read bank and login codes sent to you by text and use them to take over your accounts.

permissions.name: RECEIVE_SMS
permissions.label: see incoming text messages as they arrive
permissions.harm: Can intercept one-time codes the moment they arrive, before you see them.

permissions.name: SEND_SMS
permissions.label: send text messages
permissions.harm: Can send messages that cost you money or spread a scam to your contacts.

permissions.name: READ_CONTACTS
permissions.label: read your contacts
permissions.harm: Can collect your contacts for spam and scams aimed at your friends and family.

permissions.name: READ_CALL_LOG
permissions.label: read your call history
permissions.harm: Can see who you call and who calls you.

permissions.name: PROCESS_OUTGOING_CALLS
permissions.label: see and redirect the calls you make
permissions.harm: Can watch or redirect your calls, for example to a scammer's number.

permissions.name: CALL_PHONE
permissions.label: place phone calls without opening the dialer
permissions.harm: Can call premium-rate numbers that cost you money.

permissions.name: ANSWER_PHONE_CALLS
permissions.label: answer your phone calls
permissions.harm: Can pick up calls without you.

permissions.name: READ_PHONE_STATE
permissions.label: read your phone number and device identity
permissions.harm: Can identify you and your phone across apps.

permissions.name: RECORD_AUDIO
permissions.label: record audio with the microphone
permissions.harm: Can listen to you and to conversations around you.

permissions.name: CAMERA
permissions.label: use the camera
permissions.harm: Can take photos or video without you noticing if it runs in the background.

permissions.name: ACCESS_FINE_LOCATION
permissions.label: know your exact location
permissions.harm: Can see where you are and where you go.

permissions.name: ACCESS_BACKGROUND_LOCATION
permissions.label: track your location even when the app is closed
permissions.harm: Can follow your movements all day without you opening it.

permissions.name: GET_ACCOUNTS
permissions.label: list the accounts on your phone
permissions.harm: Can see which email and service accounts you use.

permissions.name: READ_CALENDAR
permissions.label: read your calendar
permissions.harm: Can see where you will be and when.

permissions.name: BODY_SENSORS
permissions.label: read body sensors
permissions.harm: Can read health sensor data.

permissions.name: SYSTEM_ALERT_WINDOW
permissions.label: draw over other apps
permissions.harm: Can draw fake screens on top of your banking or login apps to steal passwords and PINs.

permissions.name: REQUEST_INSTALL_PACKAGES
permissions.label: install other apps
permissions.harm: Can install more apps that Play Protect has not checked first.

permissions.name: MANAGE_EXTERNAL_STORAGE
permissions.label: access all files on the phone
permissions.harm: Can read, copy or delete your photos, documents and downloads.

permissions.name: PACKAGE_USAGE_STATS
permissions.label: see which apps you use and when
permissions.harm: Can learn your habits and know when you open your banking app.

permissions.name: QUERY_ALL_PACKAGES
permissions.label: see every app installed
permissions.harm: Can profile you or look for apps to attack.

permissions.name: WRITE_SETTINGS
permissions.label: change system settings
permissions.harm: Can change phone settings without asking.

permissions.name: DISABLE_KEYGUARD
permissions.label: turn off the lock screen
permissions.harm: Can remove the screen lock while it runs.

permissions.name: REQUEST_IGNORE_BATTERY_OPTIMIZATIONS
permissions.label: keep running in the background
permissions.harm: Can stay active all the time, which spyware relies on.

signals.label: has Accessibility access
signals.harm: Can read everything on your screen and tap or type for you. This is how many banking trojans steal money.

signals.label: can read all your notifications
signals.harm: Can read your messages and one-time codes in notifications.

signals.label: is a device administrator
signals.harm: Can lock your phone, wipe it and resist being uninstalled.

signals.label: was not installed from a known app store
signals.harm: It was not checked by an app store, so nobody vetted it before it reached your phone.

signals.label: has no icon in your app list
signals.harm: Hiding from the app list is a common trick to keep you from noticing or removing an app.

combinations.harm: It can read your texts and your notifications, which is everything needed to intercept one-time codes.
Accessibility plus drawing over other apps is the classic recipe of banking trojans: it can show a fake login screen and then tap buttons for you.
An app from outside a store that can install further apps may be a dropper for malware.
A hidden app with powerful access is a strong sign of spyware or malware.
An app from outside a store that can read and send texts can steal codes and send scam or premium messages.
Microphone, constant location and contacts in an app from outside a store look like spyware.
